title: 纪念日
prompt:
Create ONE high-fidelity flat desktop web UI concept for DooKnow / To Doo, using the provided image as the canonical STYLE and navigation reference. Same full-screen framing, same restrained blue-gray palette, white main surface, pale-gray consolidated left sidebar, crisp Chinese typography, consistent readable control sizes, thin dividers, 6–8px radii, no browser/device chrome, no 3D/perspective, no marketing poster, no watermarks.
Preserve the brand, workspace selector, list names and other navigation labels from the reference; move the active highlight to the correct destination for this screen and remove the old highlight. The To Doo brand/workspace menu provides the home/目标总览 and return-to-knowledge navigation. Use the whole main region with aligned title, controls and content. Do not keep the reference task detail pane unless this screen explicitly needs it. No floating filter bullet lists, duplicated scope dropdowns, tiny labels, random dashboard widgets or enormous decorative empty areas. Use Chinese UI text and sensible sample content. All date examples are in November 2026; Nov 4 is Wednesday. Controls and totals must agree with visible content. Reuse supported task, goal, focus, habit, anniversary, notification, settings and Markdown-note concepts; never claim global automatic saving, AI generation or fake collaboration. Render only the application UI.

SCREEN REQUIREMENTS:
Design "纪念日", sidebar纪念日 active. Header with "+ 新建纪念日" and quiet tabs全部/即将到来/今天/已过去. Four bounded elegant cards across the usable main width, each ~280–320px, not a single stretched banner: 结婚纪念日 — "就是今天", date11月4日, "5周年"; 加入团队纪念日 — "还有7天",11月11日; 家人的生日 — "还有34天",12月8日; 第一次旅行 — one-time past event, "已过去", "原日期2025年10月12日" (DO NOT say下次). Calm large countdown typography, muted supporting dates and simple overflow/edit actions. Current conceptual date is2026年11月4日. Small recurring/lunar indicators only where meaningful; no made-up lunar-to-Gregorian conversion. Preserve navigation style and generous but purposeful whitespace; no task-detail pane.
